title: Correct formula application
description: Essential Criteria: Student must use the magnetic flux formula Φ = B·S·cosθ with the correct angle interpretation.

title: Angle interpretation
description: Important Criteria: Student must correctly identify that θ is the angle between the magnetic field direction and the normal to the coil plane.

title: Numerical calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student must compute Φ = 0.6 × 0.4 × cos(60°) = 0.12 Wb as the final answer.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Student should include proper units (Wb or T·m²) in the final answer.

title: Angle confusion error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Using sinθ instead of cosθ, or misinterpreting the 60° as the complement.

title: Sign consideration
description: Optional Criteria: Student may discuss that flux is a scalar quantity, though sign indicates direction through surface.
